mapper.insert: INSERT INTO experience_route_item (route_id, poi_id, sequence, recommendation_reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{routeId}, #{poiId}, #{sequence}, #{recommendationReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE experience_route_item SET route_id=#{routeId}, poi_id=#{poiId}, sequence=#{sequence}, recommendation_reason=#{recommendationReason}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, route_id, poi_id, sequence, recommendation_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM experience_route_item WHERE route_id=#{routeId} ORDER BY sequence ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE experience_route_item SET sequence = sequence + #{offset}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE route_id=#{routeId}
